viaInPadProcess: Epoxy filled and copper capped, as already specified for this board
layoutPreservation: All 153 assembled placements and 326 earlier trace paths remain fixed. New L4 branches reserve a small portion of the lower power-plane edges. Recheck the existing VCCL/VDD DC screen after repouring.

projectInputDcScreen.basis: Conservative input-feed sizing screen. Each regulator has a 3 A output design envelope, at approximately 1.9 V or 1.13 V. The assumed 2 A input per buck is a project margin, not an ASMedia load specification or a regulator current limit.

qualification.scope: Layout and resistive conductor screen. Connector/cable loss, ground-return loss, dynamic input current, ripple, startup, stability, fault protection and temperatures require separate qualification. The existing bridge-rail 3 A / 8 mV criterion remains unchanged.
